raw_l2.verification_scope: All 62 canonical fields matched case-insensitively to sample columns; this verifies physical schema, not every semantic formula or all source files

limitations: No per-record available_time, ingested_time or exchange source_sequence; source_row is provenance only
TRADINGTIME is timezone-naive; full-file UNIX offset check supports Asia/Shanghai interpretation but does not prove availability
Snapshot feed does not identify true individual orders, executions or cancellations
Update publication mechanism, calendar, tick sizes, multipliers, sentinel policy and downstream point-in-time use require explicit configuration
Word contains spelling/OCR errors; retain original document_spelling and document_type separately from verified sample schema
Source filenames can disagree with SYMBOL/product; retain both and use record fields for contract identity
